principle: Ingress interpretation must preserve explicit meaning and explicit authorization. Inference may resolve ambiguity inside scope but may not create authority or change action class.
gateway_requirements: identify authorization envelope before routing mutating or external-effect actions
reject unstated premise or consent insertion
reject capability or access being treated as authorization
reject artifact-type substitution without explicit authorization
propagate binding corrections and invalidate conflicting downstream plans
resolve material ambiguity from authoritative context or one minimal clarification
resolve nonmaterial ambiguity using the narrowest reversible interpretation within scope
route action requests only to authorized execution surfaces
enforce stop condition when objective is satisfied

routing_rule.match: candidate_tool_action_class must equal or be a strict subset of authorized_action_class
